description: WSO2 SAP S/4HANA Material Stock provides a way to interact with the [Material Stock - Read API](https://api.sap.com/api/API_MATERIAL_STOCK_SRV/overview). The service allows to retrieve material stock information, for example, for consumption by external warehouse applications.
key-features: Query material stock quantities by material, plant, storage location and batch
Read stock types and special stock indicators for accurate availability checks
Read serial numbers of materials held in stock
